rows.cause: Naphtha inlet to the tank is blocked by UV-0101 inadvertently closed. Loss of feed to the Naphtha Tank with a continuous flow to the HPU.
rows.consequence: This results in loss of liquid level in the Naphtha Tank with continuous Naphtha pump running. Due to 5 inventory provision, loss of production at the HPU is not anticipated, but the worst case is pump cavitation, loss of containment at the pump seal, and fire scenarios.

ipls.text: Interlock IS-10 : LSLL-0102A to stop the Naphtha Pumps (-1)

rows.recommendation: 1) SIF -01 : SIL Classification of IS-10 for LSLL-0102A.

rows.cause: Naphtha inlet to the tank is blocked by UV-0101 inadvertently closed. Loss of feed to the Naphtha Tank with a continuous flow to the HPU.
rows.consequence: Blocked outlet case from the exitsing process unit to the Naphtha Tank. No loss of containment due to design pressure of transferline can withstand the unstream pump shut-off pressure at 150#. No safety issue.

rows.cause: Naphtha outlet to the Naphtha Transfer pump blocked by UV-0102 inadvertently closed.
rows.consequence: Loss of naphtha to the Naphtha Transfer pump (100P-01A/B) results in pump cavitation, loss of containment at the pump seal, and fire scenarios.

ipls.text: Interlock IS-10 : Limit switch ZSC-0102 to stop the Naphtha Pumps (-1)

rows.recommendation: 2) SIF -02 : SIL Classification of IS-10 for ZSC-1-12 to stop the Naphtha Pump.

rows.cause: Naphtha outlet to the Naphtha Transfer pump blocked by UV-0102 inadvertently closed.
rows.consequence: Thermal expansion at some blocked in volume leading to pipe leak, loss of containment and fire.

rows.cause: The Naphtha Transfer pump inadvertently stops.
rows.consequence: This results in loss of feed to the HPU. Due to 5 inventory provision, loss of production at the HPU is not anticipated, but the worst case is pump cavitation, loss of containment at the pump seal, and fire scenarios.

rows.cause: The Naphtha Transfer pump inadvertently stops.
rows.consequence: Due to continuous feed of Naphtha to the tank, this results in liquid level built up until liquid overfillling, loss of containment, and possible pool fire.

ipls.text: Interlock IS-9 : LSHH-0102A to close UV-0101 (-1)

rows.recommendation: 3) SIF -03 : SIL Classification of IS-9 for LSHH-0102 to close UV-0101.

rows.cause: PCV-0101 stuck closes resulting in no nitrogen blanketing supply.
rows.consequence: Possible tank underpressure in vacuum condition, loss of containment, and possible pool fire.

rows.cause: PCV-0102 stuck closes resulting overpressure in the tank.
rows.consequence: Overpressure inside the tank and tank's roof damage,possible tank pool fire.

rows.cause: The activated carbon at the vent line is blocked resulting in no nitrogen blanketing supply.
rows.consequence: Overpressure inside the tank and tank's roof damage,possible tank pool fire.
